summary: The agent successfully completed an HP filter correlation task with key learnings: (1) handling mixed annual/quarterly data by averaging available quarters for partial years, (2) using regex to distinguish annual from quarterly markers in 'Year marker' columns, (3) implementing HP filter manually when statsmodels unavailable, (4) verifying cyclical mean ≈ 0. The existing skill covers the core workflow well but needs enhancement for data parsing patterns and manual HP filter fallback. No new skill needed - update existing macroeconomic-hp-correlation skill with quarterly data handling patterns and a manual HP filter implementation reference.
